September Midwest Mini Swap!
Focus of event is Miniature Wargaming, including Warhammer, AOS, Warhammer 40k and other miniature games. We also welcome board games or similar material.

When: September 27th from 10 AM – 2 PM
Where: VFW New Berlin, located at M Beloit Rd, New Berlin, WI 53146
The cost to enter the Swap Meet is $5 at the door. Kids under 15 are free
